title: Albanese government warned it is ‘sleepwalking into another robodebt scenario’ over use of algorithms and AI
paragraphs: The federal government is “sleepwalking its way into another robodebt” scandal amid a lack of transparency and legislation around the use of algorithms and AI in decisions, the chief executive of the independent thinktank the Centre for Public Integrity said.
Dr Catherine Williams launched the centre’s “Computer Says No” report on Thursday, which examines the use of automated decision-making (ADM) tools by the government and calls for urgent reform.
The centre is concerned Australians may not know whether ADM has been used in decisions affecting them.
